description: Reviewed exemptions from the content-constraint lexicon, for strings in JSON files that cannot carry an inline `// constraint-ok:` comment. Distinct from docs/lint-baseline.json: a baseline entry is unreviewed legacy debt awaiting remediation; an exemption is a decision that was made, justified, and recorded. Matched on file + json_path + constraint, which is stable across reformatting.
policy: Rule 1 governs causal claims linking ENVIRONMENTAL EXPOSURE to POPULATION HEALTH OUTCOME. It does not govern established intra-organism pathophysiology. A carve-out requires all three of: (a) both subject and object are anatomical, cellular, or molecular; (b) neither is a population, a person, or an environmental exposure; (c) a citation is attached or the claim is textbook physiology. Every exemption is per-string and must state its reason.

exemptions.matched_string: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is the leading cause of dementia, characterized by progressive neurodegeneration
exemptions.reason: intra-organism mechanism per R2 carve-out; subject and object both molecular/anatomical. Full clause: 'early-onset familial AD (5-10%) is caused by rare mutations in APP, PSEN1, and PSEN2' - subject is a set of germline mutations, object is a disease phenotype. No environmental exposure and no population appears in the claim. Textbook Mendelian genetics.

exemptions.matched_string: Ischemic stroke results from occlusion of cerebral arteries, causing focal brain ischemia and infarction
exemptions.reason: intra-organism mechanism per R2 carve-out; subject and object both molecular/anatomical. Subject is arterial occlusion, object is focal brain ischemia and infarction - both anatomical structures within one organism. No environmental exposure and no population appears in the claim. Textbook pathophysiology.
